description: A word bank of the words Japanese children learn in school (四字熟語, 慣用句, proverbs, onomatopoeia, synonyms and antonyms) with fill-the-blank, pick-the-synonym and usage yes/no drills.
inspiredBy: 小学生の語彙力アップ 実践練習ドリル1100 (structure and drill formats only; no content used)
